name: grimmsnarl_ml_v14
policy: Exact v8 champion in every matchup, plus the measured Petrel/dead-Stamp residual and a one-decision wall-development safety gate. v13's v9 and wall full-policy overrides are removed.

router.information: opponent active, bench, discard, pre-evolutions and stadium only

residual.board_condition: the opponent took no prize during their last turn, and no Unfair Stamp is already in hand

wall_guard.trigger: v8 selected Shadow Bullet, active damage is zero, Bench-30 takes no prize, and fallback offers a non-closing action
protected: free swing when fallback also attacks or ends

rejected_v13_experts.wall_state_machine: 1-10 over routed v13 games; it changed roughly 20-58 decisions per wall game and became the whole policy rather than a validator
rejected_v13_experts.v9_alakazam: 8-7 over routed v13 games; the model was trained as a generic four-teacher consensus, not an Alakazam specialist

description: A falsifiable recovery from v13: retain its successful return to v8, remove both unvalidated full-policy specialists, and keep only narrow residuals whose protected states are explicit.
